g.title: ACOHH
g.text: ACO-HH — Ant Colony Optimisation Hyper-Heuristic (Chen et al. 2007 scheme)

Ants walk a graph whose vertices are low-level operators, not customers. Pheromone τ[i][j] and visibility η[i][j] live on operator→operator transitions; each journey is an operator sequence applied to the ant's current routing solution. Objective minimised: routing cost + pv · (# capacity-violating routes), with strategic oscillation of pv.

g.title: cluster_construct
g.text: — from-scratch variant used by hyper-heuristic callers

g.title: a_params
g.text: Load capacity, R, C · HyperACOParams from config
time_limit=30 s, stagnation_limit=10, elitism_ratio, operators, seed)

g.title: a_sub
g.text: Sub-problem: vrpp → all bins with mandatory list,

g.title: a_map
g.text: map local routes → global tour · km on full matrix

g.title: i_tau
g.text: τ = full((n_ops+1) × n_ops, τ₀) (row n_ops = virtual start)

g.title: i_pv
g.text: pv = initial_pv · Z = 1 % of initial cost (dynamic-λ scale)

g.title: m_place
g.text: Uniform placement: ant k starts on operator vertex k mod n_ops
apply that starting operator once to each ant's solution

g.title: m_ret
g.text: return best_routes, revenue − cost, cost / C

g.title: m_ants
g.text: S_k, sequence, η_updates, end_vertex = build_solution(S_k, position_k) (see 3.)

g.title: m_sort
g.text: sort ant results by final objective (ascending)

g.title: j_seq
g.text: SELECT SEQUENCE (AS proportional rule), L = n_ops steps:
sample next vertex, append operator, move on

g.title: m_upd
g.text: are reset to best (ratio 1 = all ants sync, paper behaviour)

g.title: m_osc
g.text: else stagnation += 1; if ≥ stagnation_limit: pv ← pv / 2
(pv < initial_pv relaxes capacity to ∞ during operator application)

g.title: m_dep
g.text: Deposit for each ant with journey improvement I_k > 0:
add Δτ along virtual-start → op₁ → op₂ → … → op_L

g.title: m_eta
g.text: Visibility: η ← eta_decay · η + Σ_k η_updates_k

g.title: j_ctx
g.text: effective_capacity = ∞ if pv < initial_pv else capacity
SWAP* cache only if 'swap_star' in sequence)

g.title: o_f
g.text: f(routes) = C · Σ route distance (depot → … → depot)
(minimised; revenue is fixed once the node set is fixed,
removal operators change it via unvisited pool)

g.title: c_boot
g.text: Bootstrap: pick one insertion heuristic uniformly at random
(greedy, blinks, nearest, farthest, savings, regret-2/3/4, deep, GENI, B&B-LDS;
profit-aware variants if profit_aware_operators) and insert all nodes into []

g.title: c_walk
g.text: place one ant on a random operator vertex
